move: glow blooms, title words rise through mask, blur clears, keynote cut left
how: A black stage with a blurred violet-pink radial glow, a small rounded logo tile, a kicker line, three gradient-filled title words and a subline, each in an overflow-hidden row, plus a dateline at the bottom. The glow scales 0.6 to 1 with opacity over the first 40% (power2.out) then drifts to scale 1.15 and xPercent 6 (sine.inOut); the logo scales in (expo.out), the kicker span rises yPercent 120 to 0, and the title words rise yPercent 115 to 0 while filter blur(14px) clears, staggered 0.12s, 12% to 40% of the duration (expo.out); the subline and dateline follow. From 82% everything exits: words slide xPercent -40 and fade with a 0.05 stagger (expo.in), kicker and sub fly up yPercent -120, logo and dateline fade, the glow shrinks and fades, so the last frame is black like the first.
adapt: Replace the kicker, title words, subline and dateline strings, the two glow colours, the title gradient and the logo tile; add or remove title words (the stagger scales with count). Keep the expo.out 1.1s word rise, the blur clear, and the fast expo.in exit at 82%.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the glow, logo, kicker, title words, sub and dateline from shot text; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same GSAP timeline with all positions scaled as fractions of D (glow 0 to 0.4D, words 0.125D, exit at 0.825D). All selectors must be scoped with el.querySelectorAll; nothing else blocks a direct port.
caveats: filter: blur(40px) on an 1100x520 glow plus animated blur on gradient-clipped text is heavy to render
from() tweens rely on immediateRender to hide elements before their start time
